123                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().queueIntel(this);
124        }

132        protected void pickLevel() {
133//              if (true) {
134//                      level = 10;
135//                      //level = Misc.random.nextInt(11);
136//                      return;
137//              }
138                
139                int base = getSharedData().getLevel();
140
141//              if (Misc.isFastStart()) {
142                        float timeFactor = (PirateBaseManager.getInstance().getDaysSinceStart() - 180f) / (365f * 2f);
143                        if (timeFactor < 0) timeFactor = 0;
144                        if (timeFactor > 1) timeFactor = 1;
145                        
146                        int add = (int) Math.round(MAX_TIME_BASED_ADDED_LEVEL * timeFactor);
147                        //base += add;
148                        base = Math.max(base, add);
149                        //base += FAST_START_LEVEL_INCREASE;
150//              }
151                
152//              if (Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet() != null) {
153//                      int playerLevel = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCommander().getStats().getLevel();
154//                      base = Math.max(base, (playerLevel - 20) / 5);
155//              }
156                
157                if (base > 10) base = 10;
158                
159//              base = 5;
160                
161                CountingMap<Integer> existing = new CountingMap<>();
162                for (EveryFrameScript s : PersonBountyManager.getInstance().getActive()) {
163                        PersonBountyIntel bounty = (PersonBountyIntel) s;
164                        
165                        int curr = bounty.getLevel();
166//                      if (curr < base || curr == 0) hasLow = true;
167//                      if (curr > base) hasHigh = true;
168                        
169                        existing.add(curr);
170                }
171                
172                boolean hasVeryLow = existing.containsKey(base - 2);
173                boolean hasVeryHigh = existing.containsKey(base + 2);;
174                
175                
176                if (!hasVeryLow && base >= 2) {
177                        level = base - 2;
178                } else if (!hasVeryHigh) {
179                        level = base + 2;
180                } else {
181                        int numLow = existing.getCount(base - 1) + Misc.random.nextInt(2);
182                        //int numLow = existing.getCount(base - 1);
183                        int numNormal = existing.getCount(base) + Misc.random.nextInt(2);
184                        int numHigh = existing.getCount(base + 1) + Misc.random.nextInt(2);
185                        
186                        if (numNormal < numLow || numNormal < numHigh) {
187                                level = base;
188                        } else if (numLow < (numNormal + numHigh) * 0.5f && base >= 1) {
189                                level = base - 1;
190                        } else  {
191                                level = base + 1;
192                        }
193                }
194                
195                if (level < 0) level = 0;
196        }

202        protected void pickHideoutLocation() {
203                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> systemPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI>();
204                for (StarSystemAPI system : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
205                        float mult = 0f;
206                        
207                        if (system.hasPulsar()) continue;
208                        
209                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP)) {
210                                mult = 1f;
211                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC)) {
212                                mult = 3f;
213                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_NO_FLEETS)) {
214                                mult = 3f;
215                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_RUINS)) {
216                                mult = 5f;
217                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_DESTROYED)) {
218                                mult = 3f;
219                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE_UNPOPULATED)) {
220                                mult = 1f;
221                        }
222                        
223                        for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getMarketsInLocation(system)) {
224                                if (market.isHidden()) continue;
225                                mult = 0f;
226                                break;
227                        }
228                        
229                        float distToPlayer = Misc.getDistanceToPlayerLY(system.getLocation());
230                        float noSpawnRange = Global.getSettings().getFloat("personBountyNoSpawnRangeAroundPlayerLY");
231                        if (distToPlayer < noSpawnRange) mult = 0f;
232                        
233                        if (mult <= 0) continue;
234                        
235                        float weight = system.getPlanets().size();
236                        for (PlanetAPI planet : system.getPlanets()) {
237                                if (planet.isStar()) continue;
238                                if (planet.getMarket() != null) {
239                                        float h = planet.getMarket().getHazardValue();
240                                        if (h <= 0f) weight += 5f;
241                                        else if (h <= 0.25f) weight += 3f;
242                                        else if (h <= 0.5f) weight += 1f;
243                                }
244                        }
245                        
246                        float dist = system.getLocation().length();
247                        float distMult = Math.max(0, 50000f - dist);
248                        
249                        systemPicker.add(system, weight * mult * distMult);
250                }
251                
252                StarSystemAPI system = systemPicker.pick();
253                
254                if (system != null) {
255                        WeightedRandomPicker<SectorEntityToken> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<SectorEntityToken>();
256                        for (SectorEntityToken planet : system.getPlanets()) {
257                                if (planet.isStar()) continue;
258                                if (planet.getMarket() != null && 
259                                                !planet.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;
260                                
261                                picker.add(planet);
262                        }
263                        hideoutLocation = picker.pick();
264                }
265                
266                
267                if (hideoutLocation == null) {
268                        endImmediately();
269                }
270        }

274        private void pickFaction() {
275                FactionAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
276
277                String commFacId = Misc.getCommissionFactionId();
278                boolean forceCommissionFaction = true;
279                if (commFacId != null && getSharedData().isParticipating(commFacId)) {
280                        for (EveryFrameScript s : PersonBountyManager.getInstance().getActive()) {
281                                PersonBountyIntel bounty = (PersonBountyIntel) s;
282                                if (bounty.faction != null && bounty.faction.getId().equals(commFacId)) {
283                                        forceCommissionFaction = false;
284                                }
285                        }
286                } else {
287                        forceCommissionFaction = false;
288                }
289                
290                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
291                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
292                        if (!getSharedData().isParticipating(market.getFactionId())) continue;
293                        if (market.getSize() < 3) continue;
294                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
295                        if (market.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) continue;
296                        
297                        float weight = market.getSize();
298                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.PATROLHQ)) weight *= 1.5f;
299                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.MILITARYBASE)) weight *= 3f;
300                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.HIGHCOMMAND)) weight *= 5f;
301
302                        if (market.getFaction() != null) {
303                                if (forceCommissionFaction && !market.getFaction().getId().equals(commFacId)) {
304                                        continue;
305                                }
306                                        
307                                if (market.getFaction().isHostileTo(player)) {
308                                        weight *= 0.5f;
309                                } else {
310                                        // turned off to vary bounties a bit more
311                                        //float rel = market.getFaction().getRelToPlayer().getRel();
312                                        //weight *= 1f + rel; // (0.5 to 2], given that it's not hostile if we're here
313                                }
314                        }
315                        
316                        if (weight > 0) {
317                                picker.add(market, weight);
318                        }
319                }
320                
321                if (picker.isEmpty()) {
322                        endImmediately();
323                        return;
324                }
325                
326                MarketAPI market = picker.pick();
327                faction = market.getFaction();
328        }

330        private void initBountyAmount() {
331                //float highStabilityMult = BaseMarketConditionPlugin.getHighStabilityBonusMult(market);
332                float highStabilityMult = 1f;
333                float base = Global.getSettings().getFloat("basePersonBounty");
334                float perLevel = Global.getSettings().getFloat("personBountyPerLevel");
335                
336                float random = perLevel * (int)(Math.random() * 15) / 15f;
337                
338                bountyCredits = (int) ((base + perLevel * level + random) * highStabilityMult);
339        }

341        private void initPerson() {
342                String factionId = Factions.PIRATES;
343                if (bountyType == BountyType.DESERTER) {
344                        factionId = faction.getId();
345                }
346                int personLevel = (int) (5 + level * 1.5f);
347                person = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId), 
348                                                                                                   personLevel, false);
349                if (level >= 7) {
350                        person.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_ADMIRAL);
351                } else {
352                        person.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN);
353                }
354        }

356        private void pickBountyType() {
357                WeightedRandomPicker<BountyType> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<BountyType>();
358                picker.add(BountyType.PIRATE, 10f);
359                
360                //if (getSharedData().getLevel() >= 3) {
361                if (level >= 4) {
362                        picker.add(BountyType.DESERTER, 30f);
363                }
364                bountyType = picker.pick();
365        }

433        @Override
434        protected void advanceImpl(float amount) {
435                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
436                //days *= 60f;
437                
438                elapsedDays += days;
439
440                if (elapsedDays >= duration && !isDone()) {
441                        boolean canEnd = fleet == null || !fleet.isInCurrentLocation();
442                        if (canEnd) {
443                                log.info(String.format("Ending bounty on %s by %s", person.getName().getFullName(), faction.getDisplayName()));
444                                result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_TIME, 0, null);
445                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, true);
446                                cleanUpFleetAndEndIfNecessary();
447                                return;
448                        }
449                }
450                
451                if (fleet == null) return;
452                
453                if (fleet.isInCurrentLocation() && !fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.PIRATES)) {
454                        fleet.setFaction(Factions.PIRATES, true);
455                } else if (!fleet.isInCurrentLocation() && !fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.NEUTRAL)) {
456                        fleet.setFaction(Factions.NEUTRAL, true);
457                }
458                
459                if (fleet.getFlagship() == null || fleet.getFlagship().getCaptain() != person) {
460                        result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_OTHER, 0, null);
461                        boolean current = fleet.isInCurrentLocation();
462                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, !current);
463                        cleanUpFleetAndEndIfNecessary();
464                        return;
465                }
466        }
467        
468        public float getTimeRemainingFraction() {
469                float f = 1f - elapsedDays / duration;
470                return f;
471        }

483        protected void cleanUpFleetAndEndIfNecessary() {
484                if (fleet != null) {
485                        Misc.makeUnimportant(fleet, "pbe");
486                        fleet.clearAssignments();
487                        if (hideoutLocation != null) {
488                                fleet.getAI().addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION_AND_DESPAWN, hideoutLocation, 1000000f, null);
489                        } else {
490                                fleet.despawn();
491                        }
492                        fleet = null; //can't null it because description uses it
493                }
494                if (!isEnding() && !isEnded()) {
495                        endAfterDelay();
496                }
497        }

499        protected boolean willPay() {
500                if (true) return true;
501                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
502                RepLevel level = playerFleet.getFaction().getRelationshipLevel(faction);
503                return level.isAtWorst(RepLevel.SUSPICIOUS);
504        }
505        
506        protected boolean willRepIncrease() {
507                if (true) return true;
508                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
509                RepLevel level = playerFleet.getFaction().getRelationshipLevel(faction);
510                return level.isAtWorst(RepLevel.HOSTILE);
511        }

513        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
514                if (isDone() || result != null) return;
515                
516                // also credit the player if they're in the same location as the fleet and nearby
517                float distToPlayer = Misc.getDistance(fleet, Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet());
518                boolean playerInvolved = battle.isPlayerInvolved() || (fleet.isInCurrentLocation() && distToPlayer < 2000f);
519                
520                if (battle.isInvolved(fleet) && !playerInvolved) {
521                        if (fleet.getFlagship() == null || fleet.getFlagship().getCaptain() != person) {
522                                fleet.setCommander(fleet.getFaction().createRandomPerson());
523                                //Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "other_end", market.getPrimaryEntity(), messagePriority);
524                                result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_OTHER, 0, null);
525                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, true);
526                                cleanUpFleetAndEndIfNecessary();
527                                return;
528                        }
529                }
530                
531                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
532                if (!playerInvolved || !battle.isInvolved(fleet) || battle.onPlayerSide(fleet)) {
533                        return;
534                }
535                
536                 // didn't destroy the original flagship
537                if (fleet.getFlagship() != null && fleet.getFlagship().getCaptain() == person) return;
538                
539                //int payment = (int) (bountyCredits * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
540                int payment = (int) bountyCredits; // don't bother about reducing the payout if the player didn't do it all themselves
541                if (payment <= 0) {
542                        result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_OTHER, 0, null);
543                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, true);
544                        cleanUpFleetAndEndIfNecessary();
545                        return;
546                }
547                
548                if (willPay()) {
549                        log.info(String.format("Paying bounty of %d from faction [%s]", (int) payment, faction.getDisplayName()));
550                        
551                        playerFleet.getCargo().getCredits().add(payment);
552                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
553                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.PERSON_BOUNTY_REWARD, null, null, null, true, false), 
554                                        faction.getId());
555                        result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_PLAYER_BOUNTY, payment, rep);
556                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this, true);
557                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, false);
558                } else if (willRepIncrease()) {
559                        log.info(String.format("Not paying bounty, but improving rep with faction [%s]", faction.getDisplayName()));
560                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
561                                                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.PERSON_BOUNTY_REWARD, null, null, null, true, false), 
562                                                                faction.getId());
563                        result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_PLAYER_NO_BOUNTY, payment, rep);
564                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this, true);
565                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, false);
566                } else {
567                        log.info(String.format("Not paying bounty or improving rep with faction [%s]", faction.getDisplayName()));
568                        result = new BountyResult(BountyResultType.END_PLAYER_NO_REWARD, 0, null);
569                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this, true);
570                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, false);
571                }
572                
573                
574                getSharedData().reportSuccess(level);
575                //removeBounty();
576                
577                cleanUpFleetAndEndIfNecessary();
578        }

592        private void spawnFleet() {
593//              level = 10;
594//              bountyType = BountyType.PIRATE;
595                
596                String fleetFactionId = Factions.PIRATES;
597                if (bountyType == BountyType.DESERTER) {
598                        fleetFactionId = faction.getId();
599                }
600                
601                float qf = (float) level / 10f;
602                if (qf > 1) qf = 1;
603                
604                String fleetName = "";
605                
606                fleetName = person.getName().getLast() + "'s" + " Fleet";
607                
608                float fp = (5 + level * 5) * 5f;
609                fp *= 0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.25f;
610                
611                if (level >= 7) {
612                        fp += 20f;
613                }
614                if (level >= 8) {
615                        fp += 30f;
616                }
617                if (level >= 9) {
618                        fp += 50f;
619                }
620                if (level >= 10) {
621                        fp += 50f;
622                }
623                
624                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(fleetFactionId);
625                float maxFp = faction.getApproximateMaxFPPerFleet(ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL) * 1.1f;
626                if (fp > maxFp) fp = maxFp;
627                
628                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
629                                null, 
630                                hideoutLocation.getLocationInHyperspace(),
631                                fleetFactionId, 
632                                qf + 0.2f, // qualityOverride
633                                FleetTypes.PERSON_BOUNTY_FLEET,
634                                fp, // combatPts
635                                0, // freighterPts 
636                                0, // tankerPts
637                                0f, // transportPts
638                                0f, // linerPts
639                                0f, // utilityPts
640                                0f // qualityMod
641                                );
642                params.ignoreMarketFleetSizeMult = true;
643//              if (route != null) {
644//                      params.timestamp = route.getTimestamp();
645//              }
646                //params.random = random;
647                fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
648                
649//              fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember("station_small_Standard");
650//              fleet.getFleetData().sort();
651                
652                if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) {
653                        endImmediately();
654                        return;
655                }
656
657                fleet.setCommander(person);
658                fleet.getFlagship().setCaptain(person);
659//              fleet.getFleetData().setSyncNeeded();
660//              fleet.getFleetData().syncIfNeeded();
661                FleetFactoryV3.addCommanderSkills(person, fleet, null);
662                
663                //Misc.getSourceMarket(fleet).getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.OFFICER_LEVEL_MULT);
664                
665                Misc.makeImportant(fleet, "pbe", duration + 20f);
666                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE, true);
667                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_NO_MILITARY_RESPONSE, true);
668                
669                fleet.setNoFactionInName(true);
670                fleet.setFaction(Factions.NEUTRAL, true);
671                fleet.setName(fleetName);
672
673                fleet.addEventListener(this);
674                
675                LocationAPI location = hideoutLocation.getContainingLocation();
676                location.addEntity(fleet);
677                fleet.setLocation(hideoutLocation.getLocation().x - 500, hideoutLocation.getLocation().y + 500);
678                fleet.getAI().addAssignment(FleetAssignment.ORBIT_AGGRESSIVE, hideoutLocation, 1000000f, null);
679                
680                flagship = fleet.getFlagship();
681
682        }

709        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
710                
711                
712                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
713                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
714                float pad = 3f;
715                float opad = 10f;
716                
717                float initPad = pad;
718                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
719                
720                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
721                
722                bullet(info);
723                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
724                
725                if (result == null) {
726//                      RepLevel level = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().getRelationshipLevel(faction.getId());
727//                      Color relColor = faction.getRelColor(Factions.PLAYER);
728//                      String rel = level.getDisplayName().toLowerCase();
729                        
730                        if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
731//                              if (!willRepIncrease()) {
732//                                      LabelAPI label = info.addPara("No reward or rep increase (" + rel + ")", bodyColor, initPad);  
733//                                      label.setHighlight("(" + rel + ")");
734//                                      label.setHighlightColors(relColor);
735//                              } else if (!willPay()) {
736//                                      LabelAPI label = info.addPara("No reward (" + rel + ")", bodyColor, initPad);  
737//                                      label.setHighlight("(" + rel + ")");
738//                                      label.setHighlightColors(relColor);
739//                              } else {
740                                        info.addPara("%s reward", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(bountyCredits));
741//                              }
742                                int days = (int) (duration - elapsedDays);
743                                if (days <= 1) {
744                                        days = 1;
745                                }
746                                addDays(info, "remaining", days, tc);
747                        } else {
748                                info.addPara("Faction: " + faction.getDisplayName(), initPad, tc,
749                                                 faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayName());
750                                if (!isEnding()) {
751                                        int days = (int) (duration - elapsedDays);
752                                        String daysStr = "days";
753                                        if (days <= 1) {
754                                                days = 1;
755                                                daysStr = "day";
756                                        }
757                                        info.addPara("%s reward, %s " + daysStr + " remaining", 0f, tc,
758                                                        h, Misc.getDGSCredits(bountyCredits), "" + days);
759                                }
760                        }
761                        unindent(info);
762                        return;
763                }
764                
765                switch (result.type) {
766                case END_PLAYER_BOUNTY:
767                        info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(result.payment));
768                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(result.rep.delta, faction, null, 
769                                        null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
770                        break;
771                case END_PLAYER_NO_BOUNTY:
772                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(result.rep.delta, faction, null, 
773                                        null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
774                        break;
775                case END_PLAYER_NO_REWARD:
776                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(result.rep.delta, faction, null, 
777                                        null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
778                        break;
779                case END_TIME:
780                        break;
781                case END_OTHER:
782                        break;
783                
784                }
785                
786                unindent(info);
787        }

868                                                opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
869                        } else {
870                                info.addPara("This bounty is no longer on offer.", opad);
871                        }
872                } else {
873//                      RepLevel level = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().getRelationshipLevel(faction.getId());
874//                      Color relColor = faction.getRelColor(Factions.PLAYER);

884//                                              " towards you, and you would receive no payment for completing the bounty, but " +
885//                                              "it would improve your standing.", opad);
886//                              label.setHighlight(faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle(), rel);
887//                              label.setHighlightColors(faction.getBaseUIColor(), relColor);
888//                      }
889                }
890                
891                addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
892                if (result == null) {
893//                      String targetDesc = getTargetDesc();
894//                      if (targetDesc != null) {
895//                              info.addPara(targetDesc, opad);
896//                      }
897                        
898                        if (hideoutLocation != null) {
899                                SectorEntityToken fake = hideoutLocation.getContainingLocation().createToken(0, 0);
900                                fake.setOrbit(Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbit(hideoutLocation, 0, 1000, 100));
901                                
902                                String loc = BreadcrumbSpecial.getLocatedString(fake);
903                                loc = loc.replaceAll("orbiting", "hiding out near");
904                                loc = loc.replaceAll("located in", "hiding out in");
905                                String sheIs = "She is";
906                                if (person.getGender() == Gender.MALE) sheIs = "He is";
907                                info.addPara(sheIs + " rumored to be " + loc + ".", opad);
908                        }
909                        
910                        
911                        int cols = 7;
912                        float iconSize = width / cols;
913                        
914                        PersonBountyEventData sd = getSharedData();
915                        
916                        if (DebugFlags.PERSON_BOUNTY_DEBUG_INFO) {// || Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
917                                boolean deflate = false;

919                                        fleet.setFaction(Factions.PIRATES, true);

921                                        deflate = true;
922                                }
923                                
924                                String her = "her";
925                                if (person.getGender() == Gender.MALE) her = "his";
926                                info.addPara("The bounty posting also contains partial intel on the ships under " + her + " command. (DEBUG: full info)", opad);
927                                info.addShipList(cols, 3, iconSize, getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor(), fleet.getMembersWithFightersCopy(), opad);
928                                
929                                info.addPara("Bounty level: %s", opad, h, "" + level);
930                                info.addPara("Level: %s, successes: %s / %s, buffer: %s", 3f, h, 
931                                                "" + sd.getLevel(), "" + sd.getSuccessesThisLevel(),
932                                                "" + sd.getThresholdForLevel(sd.getLevel()), "" + sd.getBuffer());
933                                info.addPara("type: " + bountyType.name(), 3f);

937                                }
938                        } else {
939                                boolean deflate = false;

941                                        fleet.setFaction(Factions.PIRATES, true);
942                                        fleet.inflateIfNeeded();
943                                        deflate = true;

946                                List<FleetMemberAPI> list = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();

953                                List<FleetMemberAPI> members = fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();

957                                        
958                                        if (member.isFighterWing()) continue;
959                                        
960                                        float prob = (float) member.getFleetPointCost() / 20f;
961                                        prob += (float) max / (float) members.size();
962                                        if (member.isFlagship()) prob = 1f;
963                                        //if (members.size() <= max) prob = 1f;
964                                        
965                                        if (random.nextFloat() > prob) continue;
966                                        
967                                        FleetMemberAPI copy = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, member.getVariant());
968                                        if (member.isFlagship()) {
969                                                copy.setCaptain(person);
970                                        }
971                                        list.add(copy);

976                                        if (person.getGender() == Gender.MALE) her = "his";

978                                        info.addShipList(cols, 1, iconSize, getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor(), list, opad);
979                                        
980                                        int num = members.size() - list.size();
981                                        num = Math.round((float)num * (1f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f));
982                                        
983                                        if (num < 5) num = 0;
984                                        else if (num < 10) num = 5;
985                                        else if (num < 20) num = 10;
986                                        else num = 20;
987                                        
988                                        if (num > 1) {
989                                                info.addPara("The intel assessment notes the fleet may contain upwards of %s other ships" +
990                                                                " of lesser significance.", opad, h, "" + num);
991                                        } else {
992                                                info.addPara("The intel assessment notes the fleet may contain several other ships" +
993                                                                " of lesser significance.", opad);
994                                        }
995                                }
996                                
997                                if (deflate) {
998                                        fleet.deflate();
999                                }
1000                                
1001                                if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
1002                                        info.addPara("Bounty level: %s", opad, h, "" + level);
1003                                        info.addPara("Level: %s, successes: %s / %s, buffer: %s", 3f, h, 
1004                                                        "" + sd.getLevel(), "" + sd.getSuccessesThisLevel(),
1005                                                        "" + sd.getThresholdForLevel(sd.getLevel()), "" + sd.getBuffer());
1006                                }
1007                        }
1008                }
1009                
1010                //info.addButton("Accept", "Accept", faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDarkUIColor(), (int)(width/2), 20f, opad);
1011
